info.title: dkrypt Public API
info.description: Use API keys to submit decrypt jobs, inspect job status, and access IPA artifacts. Responses include X-Dkrypt-API-Version and rate-limit metadata. Breaking changes receive a new compatibility version and advance notice.

policy.compatibility: Additive changes remain within the current version; breaking changes receive a new compatibility version.

RateLimit.description: Available quota and effective window using the current IETF RateLimit header field format.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Configured request quota policy using the current IETF RateLimit header field format.
